extracted.name: Ching’s Hakka noodles
extracted.description: The regular Chinese noodles right from home instantly!!!
ingredient_lines: Onion, ginger garlic chopped, carrot, capsicum,any vegetables of ur choice
Chilli,soya, and all shezwan sauce etc
instruction_lines: First boil noodles in very hot water for about 2 minutes only bite like noodles u must strain away water & drizzle drops of oil to leave it non sticky
Fry chopped vegetables 50 percent then add sauces & noodles give a nice stir
Tip of the day: U can garnish with scrambled eggs or chicken stir fried.
